subject: [video] WP05 re-run after the 03:43 mb.c edit: same hadamard16 overflow
body: Still aborts, same values (-1296911689 + -1246382667) at n2avc_xform.c:231 through n2avc_inv_dc16. The encoder was opened with qp=26, bitrate=0, fps 30/1, keyint 60, threads 1, flags 0 (my glue's defaults; n2avc_open accepted them). If your CLI at --qp 26 on a 640x480 frame does not show it, the difference may be the source content (mine is a flat-ish moving gradient) or the intra mode choice; my pixel buffer is 420v with stride >= width from the fake. Full command: WP05_REAL=1 bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh. I can supply the exact YUV my fake pixel buffer holds if that helps, but the encoder should not overflow on any legal input, so I am treating it as ubsan-clean work on your side.
